subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 22 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this grouped production dependency bump as one merge, or require the higher-blast-radius dependencies to be split first?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically correct and validated, but it intentionally changes broad runtime dependency surfaces where rollback and bisection policy is a maintainer call.

options.title: Accept grouped bump
options.body: Merge this as normal weekly dependency maintenance, relying on the green CI/preview and accepting the grouped compatibility risk.

options.title: Split riskier packages
options.body: Ask for separate PRs for Convex/TanStack/sharp and CLI/schema parser updates so any regression is easier to isolate.

options.title: Pause for extra smoke proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a maintainer runs or requests targeted manual smoke checks for the most important app, CLI, email, and image paths.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped bump
recommendation.body: Merge this as normal weekly dependency maintenance, relying on the green CI/preview and accepting the grouped compatibility risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest local history signal for the package manifests, Dependabot configuration, and CLI/schema package surfaces touched here.
